These are the slides I presented at the World Biodiversity Forum 2026 in Davos as part of the session: Shaping Biodiverse Futures: Applying the Nature Futures Framework for Scenario Development from Local to National Levels. This was a great opportunity to candidly share some of our experiences of successes and challenges in developing national scale Nature Futures Framework (NFF) scenarios a spart of large scale projects in both Switzerland and Peru with some of the researchers responsible for developing the NFF as well as other practictioners.
